notes: Auto-apply plan: after Assess, one button finds every raw frame of the photo's session (laptop, DWARF over USB-C or Wi-Fi), copies them to a processing folder after a space check, restacks in Siril with the plan's frame selection, crops, runs GraXpert, plate solves and colour calibrates, then finishes the plan and saves FITS/TIFF/JPG. Set the processing folder in Settings.
